description_en: Deletes a specified application version, or deletes the entire application and its adapters if the version ID is omitted
description_zh: 删除指定应用版本；省略版本 ID 时删除整个应用及其适配
name: DeleteApp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application to be deleted. This parameter is required, and the application must belong to the current account. You must dissociate image references from the target application or version before deletion
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的应用 ID。必须提供，且应用属于当前账号。删除前须解除目标应用或版本的镜像引用
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application version to be deleted. If specified, only the adapters corresponding to this application version are deleted. If omitted, the entire application and its adapters are deleted. If the application has no other adapters after the version is deleted, the application record is also deleted
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的应用版本 ID。指定时只删除该应用版本对应的适配；省略时删除整个应用及其适配。若删除版本后应用已无其他适配，应用记录也会删除
parameters.name: app_version_id

schema.description_en: The response of the API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Code.description_en: The error code. Returned when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this field
Code.description_zh: 错误码。请求失败时返回；成功响应可能不包含该字段

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful. A value of true indicates that the operation is successful
Data.description_zh: 本次操作是否处理成功。true 表示操作成功

Message.description_en: The error or result message. This field describes the cause when a request fails. A successful response may not contain this field
Message.description_zh: 错误或结果提示。请求失败时用于说明原因，成功响应可能不包含该字段

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can provide this value when you troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，排查问题时可提供该值

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is successful. For asynchronous tasks, you must query the task status separately to check whether the task is completed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步任务是否完成须另外查询任务状态
